items.content: Exactly two Jest probes in test/archive.test.js. Control: archive weekly with a jest.fn runner and assert it received tar with ['-czf', 'weekly.tgz', 'reports']. Exploit: archive 'weekly; touch /tmp/pwned', assert Error invalid archive name and assert the runner was never called. archiveReport in lib/archive.js owns name validation; only the process runner may be replaced by a recorder.
Report names from the export form are used to build an archive command. A name containing ; touch /tmp/pwned may run an extra command on the server.
